prompts.title: Racha reciente
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, duration about 8 seconds, permanent lower quarter reserved for yellow subtitles (never place chart content below that line). EDITORIAL VARIANT: kinetic typography — the Spanish headline «ÚLTIMOS PARTIDOS» wipes in from the left in warm white on GoatLab charcoal #101412, then the words «VICTORIAS», «EMPATES», «DERROTAS» punch in one per beat, each team name in lime #c5ed74 (Feyenoord Rotterdam) and slate #8ca6bf (Como 1907), oversized condensed uppercase, letter-spacing tightening on impact. Sub-word scale shifts and a hard rhythm drive emphasis; one focal point at a time. No axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. Exit with a diagonal transition wipe. STATISTICAL VARIANT: grouped count bars on a shared zero baseline running horizontally across the upper two-thirds. Three category groups — Spanish labels «Victorias», «Empates», «Derrotas» — each holding two bars: Feyenoord Rotterdam in lime, Como 1907 in slate. Bar length is the count in partidos, with a single shared linear scale and a zero marker visible on the left. Axis label «Partidos», values resolved by the renderer as {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}. Annotate unequal or equal samples honestly with Spanish labels «Muestra: Feyenoord {{home.n}} partidos» and «Muestra: Como {{away.n}} partidos», plus a source line «Fuente: Bzzoiro — fixture Feyenoord vs Como»; keep the source and sample annotation attached to the bars at all times. Temporal stages: 0–2s headline entry; 2–5s baseline and groups draw in left-to-right with staggered ease-out; 5–7s the largest winning count receives a lime outline pulse as emphasis while the comparison between the two teams is held side by side; 7–8s exit. Entry animation slides from the right edge; camera performs a subtle push-in of about five frames of scale, then a short pan to the comparison focal point. Use a cross-fade transition to the next scene and exit with a vertical shutter.

prompts.title: Balance de goles
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, roughly 9 seconds, lower quarter permanently clear for yellow subtitles. EDITORIAL VARIANT: an illustrative football pitch drawn in slate #8ca6bf line work on charcoal #101412, tilted in gentle perspective, with no statistical axes. Two stylised ball paths arc across the pitch in lime #c5ed74 — one from the left half labelled «Feyenoord Rotterdam», one from the right half labelled «Como 1907» — each path swelling into a glowing impact ring at the top of the frame. The Spanish headline «GOLES» scales up with a whip-crack easing, followed by the narration phrase from the audio as kinetic type. Emphasis comes from a single focal ball rotating slowly at centre frame. No sample claims, no invented match events, no axes. Transition: ball rolls across the screen as a mask wipe; exit via a flash cut. STATISTICAL VARIANT: paired bars for both teams on one shared linear scale with a visible zero baseline, arranged as two row pairs — Spanish labels «Goles a favor» and «Goles recibidos». Feyenoord Rotterdam bars in lime, Como 1907 bars in slate, identical widths, identical scale across all four bars so comparison is unambiguous. Values are {{home.gf}}, {{home.ga}}, {{away.gf}}, {{away.ga}}, unit label «Goles». Football context is given by a small pitch icon behind the group header rather than by extra data. Source and sample annotation sits under the axis: «Fuente: Bzzoiro — muestra de {{home.n}} partidos (Feyenoord) y {{away.n}} partidos (Como)». Temporal stages: 0–2s headline and pitch draw on with stroke-dash; 2–6s bars extend from the zero baseline outward in sequence, paired so the two teams read together; 6–8s the largest single bar gets a lime halo as emphasis while the paired comparison remains on screen; 8–9s exit. Camera: slow dolly-in toward the focal pair, then a subtle tilt up. Cross-fade transition into the next scene, exit with a horizontal blind wipe.

prompts.title: Arcos en cero
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 8 seconds, with the lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. EDITORIAL VARIANT: defensive energy — a stylised shield forms at centre frame from rotating arcs, charcoal #101412 body with lime #c5ed74 rim light, slate #8ca6bf inner grid. The Spanish headline «SIN ENCAJAR GOL» enters letter by letter with a hard snap, then the team names «Feyenoord Rotterdam» and «Como 1907» alternate below in opposing corners, one in lime and one in slate, each triggering a shield pulse on the beat. One focal point: the shield core. No statistical axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. Motion: the shield compresses on impact and rebounds with an elastic easing; a thin diagonal light sweep crosses it. Entry is a radial expansion from the shield centre; transition to the next scene uses a shield-shaped iris; exit is a scale-down into a single lime dot. STATISTICAL VARIANT: two vertical count bars on a shared zero baseline with a common linear scale, Spanish labels «Arcos en cero» and the team names as direct bar labels. Feyenoord Rotterdam in lime, Como 1907 in slate. Values are {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}}, unit «Partidos». Counts are shown as raw counts only and are never converted into rates. A clearly separated Spanish annotation carries the source and sample: «Fuente: Bzzoiro — muestra de {{home.n}} partidos y {{away.n}} partidos». Temporal stages: 0–2s headline and axis draw in; 2–5s bars grow upward from the baseline with a staggered ease-out; 5–7s the larger count is emphasised with a lime outline and a subtle scale lift while both bars stay visible for comparison; 7–8s exit. Camera holds nearly static with a slight push-in, then pans down to the source line. Transition: soft cross-fade; exit with an upward shutter.

prompts.title: Tensión del partido
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 10 seconds, lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles. EDITORIAL VARIANT: team reveals and narrative emphasis — a hard vertical split sweeps across the frame, lime #c5ed74 side revealing «Feyenoord Rotterdam», slate #8ca6bf side revealing «Como 1907», both team names in large condensed uppercase Spanish over charcoal #101412. The narration phrase appears as kinetic type in warm white #edf0e6, word by word, with a single word flashing lime on the emphasised beat. Shapes are abstract: angled panels, motion trails and a thin centre line that flexes as if pulled by both sides — a visual duel, no axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. Entry is a panel split from centre; transition is a wipe along the centre line; exit is a zoom past both panels. STATISTICAL VARIANT: one grounded statistical tension shown as two indicator bars on a shared zero baseline with a single common linear scale — Spanish labels «Goles a favor de Feyenoord» ({{home.gf}}, lime) against «Goles recibidos por Como» ({{away.ga}}, slate), unit «Goles»; a secondary small pair beneath repeats the form tension «Victorias» with {{home.wins}} and {{away.wins}} on the same partidos scale so all comparisons share units. Two clearly separated Spanish annotation blocks keep source and sample attached: «Fuente: Bzzoiro — muestra de {{home.n}} partidos (Feyenoord) y {{away.n}} partidos (Como)» and a label «Historial publicado; no es una predicción». No estimates appear because none are published in the catalog. Temporal stages: 0–2.5s team reveal panels enter with a split; 2.5–6s primary bars extend from zero with ease-out while the secondary pair fades in beneath; 6–8.5s the primary comparison receives emphasis — a lime pulse travelling from the taller bar to the shorter one; 8.5–10s both pairs hold with the source annotation locked on screen. Camera: slow push-in through the split, then a slight parallax drift between the two panels. Transition into the next scene is a cross-fade; exit is a centre-line wipe closing the frame.
